question: Should the keyless Tomorrow.io path (GET /v4/timelines in the lat,lon query form for core fields and map tiles, with no account, limited to 2 a second, 50 an hour and 200 a day by IP address) be its own record with tier keyless and identity anonymous?
why: A verify lane cannot add a record. The path needs no account, which differs from the Free plan's email sign-up, and its limits differ from the Free plan's 500 a day, 25 an hour and 3 a second; today it is described only in tooling and interface_detail of data-apis/tomorrow-io. Some keyless answers carry no rate-limit headers and the counters do not always fall by one per call, so the limits may be counted per gateway node: a burst of 20 concurrent calls drew 14 answers of HTTP 200 and 6 of HTTP 429 (code 429001, Retry-After 1), and six concurrent calls all answered HTTP 200.
